sections.zh:
长久以来，我们[Root.GetAdj]都享受着海洋的宁静，我们的身体结构似乎都完全适应了在水中生存。

生存有如逆水行舟，不进则退。我们不能确定这个宇宙中是否还有他者，我们的家园会不会是一颗随时可能被摘走的明珠。

我们一直呆在一方小小的池塘里，受着星云的庇护，但这已为陈迹。随着[GetStartingDrive]发明，我们已经准备好去往无尽的星辰大海中航行。
sections.en:
Long have we [Root.GetAdj] been able to enjoy the tranquility of the ocean, and our very frames seem optimized for an aquatic existence.

But existence is a swirling current, and if we do not adapt, we invite stagnation. We cannot be sure we are alone in this universe, and our home world is a pearl that risks being plucked.

We have stayed in a small pond, protected by our nebula, but no longer. With the introduction of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to sail the endless stellar seas.
